_comment: Overrides and notes for the generated SDK reference. `descriptions` replace a JSDoc comment that is wrong, internal, or missing; `notes` are appended under an entry. Keys are `Symbol` or `Symbol.member`. scripts/generate.mjs fails if a key no longer matches an exported symbol or member, or if a JSDoc that mentions an internal note has no override. Why each description is overridden: ClientConfig.accountSlug says the slug is 'found in your dashboard' (it is not shown there); TunnelClientConfig.hubUrl/timeout/localDiscovery use a placeholder host, an internal constant name, and an unmeasured latency claim; TunnelResponse.body's JSDoc refers to internal notes. Fixing the source comments is in docs backlog.

descriptions.ClientConfig.accountSlug: Your account slug: the part of your tunnel URL before `--`. The agent prints your full URL when it connects. Env: `VHYXVOID_ACCOUNT_SLUG`.
descriptions.TunnelClientConfig.localDiscovery: Look for an agent on the same machine (port 4242) and send requests to it directly instead of through the hub. Default: `true`. Set `false` to always go through the hub.
descriptions.TunnelResponse.body: A text response (JSON, HTML, plain text) is a `string`. A binary response (image, PDF, audio, `application/octet-stream`) is a `Buffer` with the original bytes. `null` when the response has no body.
descriptions.RequestOptions.timeout: Timeout for this request in milliseconds. Overrides the client's.
descriptions.ClientConfig.label: Which tunnel to call: the part of the tunnel URL after `--`. Default: `default`. Env: `VHYXVOID_LABEL`.
descriptions.ClientConfig.baseUrl: Use this URL instead of building one from `accountSlug`, `label` and `hubDomain`. Handy for tests.
descriptions.ClientConfig.hubDomain: Domain the tunnel URL is built from. Default: `vhyxvoid.com`. Env: `VHYXVOID_HUB_DOMAIN`.
descriptions.ClientConfig.onRequest: Called before every request, with the request that is about to be sent. It can change `req.headers`, for example to add a token.

notes.TunnelClientConfig.timeout: The published `@vhyxvoid/sdk` 1.1.0 defaults to 30000 (30 seconds). The source has moved to 120000, in step with the hub's default request timeout, and that applies from the next SDK release.
notes.ClientConfig.timeout: This is the client's own limit, measured by your process, and it is separate from the hub's request timeout (see [Tunnel request timeout](/reference/environment-variables#tunnel-request-timeout)). A slow route fails at 30 seconds here even if the hub would still be waiting, so raise it for slow endpoints.
notes.TunnelClient: Node.js only, and it takes your API key secret. See [Limitations](/limitations#the-sdk-is-nodejs-only).
